thesis: Fundamentals are high quality and cheap: revenue YoY +105.85%, operating margin 65.2%, forward P/E 10.91. RSI14 28.7 on 2.6x volume suggests the stock is oversold. But the technical card declares no setup in a confirmed downtrend below SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200. The pre-market quote of 160.70 is already below the 163.4 stop and the 165.89 swing low. The cause of the 24% 21-day selloff is unknown because the news feed failed, and earnings on 2026-11-17 fall inside the holding window. The bull concedes there is no entry before a reclaim and the print, so this is a watchlist name, not a new position.
invalidation: The Hold-not-Buy view is void only if price reclaims and closes above 165.89 and the 2026-11-17 earnings print removes the binary event; in that case re-anchor levels to the new tape instead of reusing these.
key_risks: Pre-market 160.70 is about 7.5% below the 173.73 close and already below the 163.4 stop, so the card's long levels are stale
